MEET THE PEOPLE WHO BRING YOU HDR REMODELING

An award-winning team that brings your home, kitchen, and bathroom remodels to life. 

HDR Remodeling is a full service residential Design Build remodeling contractor providing services to Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, El Cerrito, Kensington, Oakland, Piedmont, and the greater East Bay Area. Our team has been providing homeowners with quality design, construction and residential remodeling services for over 30 years. 

CHRIS FELLOWS - PRESIDENT

Meet Chris - Chris Fellows is the President of HDR Remodeling. He and his qualified staff of skilled Project Managers and Lead Carpenters will bring your project to life. With 25 years of experience in construction, Chris directs HDR Remodeling's trade professionals, vendors, and suppliers like a conductor directs an orchestra. He has been with the HDR Remodeling family since 2009.

Chris carries a California Contractor’s License for General Building Contractor B and Class C-6 Cabinet, and Finish Carpentry. He is also a NARI certified Certified Remodeling Project Manager (CRPM), LEAD R&R Certified, C2 Asbestos Hazard Safety Certified, and Window & Door certified Winteq Installer.

KEVIN MOND - VICE PRESIDENT

Kevin Mond is Vice President of HDR Remodeling and leads Business Development and Marketing. He is normally the first point of contact for new clients. Kevin shows a strong passion for the Design-Build process and truly believes this method is the most effective way for remodeling single family residences. Growing up in a family of architects, engineers and builders this industry runs in his blood. 

Kevin likes to spend his free time with his wife and son in the outdoors. You will often find him camping, surfing or trail running in the mountains.

Originally from Argentina, Kevin grew up in Iowa. He holds a degree in Architecture and Environmental Studies. While in school, he worked on projects in Holland, Germany and Sweden. Kevin joined HDR Remodeling in 2012.

MILTON TONG - ARCHITECT

Meet Milton - Milton Tong is a California Licensed Architect focused on residential architecture.  With over 30 years of experience in many building types, contemporary and traditional architectural styles, and construction detailing for custom work, Milton brings a broad range of expertise to find the best solution to your unique aesthetic and needs. He has a Bachelor of Architecture from Cal Poly, and Masters of Architecture from UC Berkeley, is a Green Point Advisor and LEED Professional.

TAMAR NACHSHON - DESIGN MANAGER

Tamar brings over a decade of expertise in interior design and architecture, specializing in residential, commercial, and mixed-use construction. She embraces each project as a unique challenge and a new opportunity to realize her clients' visions. By considering both the aesthetic and functional aspects of a home, Tamar crafts distinctive design solutions that balance daily practicality with budgetary constraints. This thoughtful approach has led to numerous successful residential projects.

Tamar holds a Bachelor of Studio Arts from UC Santa Cruz and a Master’s in Interior Architecture from Cal Poly Pomona. She is also LEED GA certified.

KENDALL CHAPMAN - DESIGNER

Kendall joined the HDR Remodeling team in 2021 and is currently a Designer. She is a creative who understands the importance of making a house feel like a home and strives to design unique interiors that reflect her client’s taste, lifestyle and personality. She offers a balance of creativity, collaboration and forward thinking with a trained eye for quality, color, and mixing of diverse elements. 

When she is not designing, Kendall can be found dabbling in photography, walking her rescue pup, or taking on DIY home improvement projects. 

JOE CLEDERA - DESIGNER

With nearly two decades of professional experience in interior design and architecture, Joe has shaped spaces across residential, retail, workplace, and commercial sectors, working with both global design consultancies and boutique studios. He is recognized for his collaborative approach, partnering closely with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver designs that are both functional and visually compelling. For Joe, great design goes beyond aesthetics—it’s about creating environments that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Outside of the studio, he enjoys traveling, cooking, gardening, and spending quality time with his family and pets.

RACHAEL DILBECK - DESIGNER

Rachael joins the HDR team as a designer with over 10 years of experience in residential remodeling and new construction. Her love for design started early with building houses out of LEGO bricks as a child, and later took her passion abroad, earning a Master’s in Interior Design in Florence, Italy. Rachael has a true talent for transforming spaces into places that are both beautiful and functional. She enjoys working closely with clients to bring their ideas to life, guiding them through every step of the process with care and attention to detail. Known for her organization and creative problem-solving, Rachael helps ensure every project runs smoothly and reflects HDR’s high standards of quality.

When she’s not designing, you’ll find Rachael jet skiing in the Delta with her boyfriend, horseback riding, discovering new wines, or curled up on the couch with her pets.

ZOEY BIRJANDIAN - DESIGNER

I’m Zoey, and I come from a fine arts background, which sparked my passion for interior design. For years, I’ve blended artistic creativity with practical design, shaping spaces that feel as good as they look. When I’m not designing, you’ll find me in the gym, tennis court or spending time with family and friends.

ERIKA LAO - HR OFFICE MANAGER

Erika has over five years of dynamic HR experience, seamlessly managing everything from employee relations to planning engaging corporate events. She holds a Bachelor of Science in Psychology I/O from CSU East Bay and a Master of Business Administration from CSU Monterey Bay. Erika is always eager to learn new systems to improve workflows and enhance employee experiences.

Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family and dog, getting crafty with DIY projects, or hitting the slopes for snowboarding adventures.

DIANAH WONG - ACCOUNTANT

Dianah is a skilled and detail-oriented accountant with 14 years of experience in financial management and accounting services. Specializing in month end reconciliation. She is proficient using various accounting software and tools to streamline processes, ensure compliance, and optimize financial reporting.  With a strong eye for accuracy and a commitment to providing reliable financial insights. Outside of work she spends time with her son and enjoys the outdoors hiking the hills of Marin County.

OUR BUILD TEAM
ALBERTO NAVARRO RUIZ - PRODUCTION MANAGER, CRPM, CLC

Alberto leads the Build Team as Production Manager. Joining HDR in 2015, he's been a long-standing member of the team where he brings over 10 years of expertise in the remodeling industry as well as a degree in Construction Management. Alberto enjoys being able to build and deliver high quality service to his clients.

He is family-oriented, outgoing, and enjoys being active outdoors and traveling in his free time.

OMAR MAHZOZ - ESTIMATOR

Omar has more than 7 years of experience in all things construction from project management and estimating, to the sales and customer service side of the industry. On weekends when he’s not at the gym, Omar spends his free time volunteering for non-profits at Save the Children and International Rescue Committee. 

COLIN EIKELAND  - PROJECT MANAGER

Colin is a Project Manager with over 25 years of experience in the design build industry. After completing a wood construction trade program, he followed a long family tradition of builders. Colin specializes in custom high-end homes and enjoys the creativity, problem-solving, and variety that each project brings. He finds great satisfaction in seeing a project transform from concept to completion. Outside of work, Colin enjoys beekeeping and backpacking.

JULIO PEREZ - PROJECT MANAGER

Julio started his career building homes from foundation to roof. Through his 25 years in residential construction, he's honed his skills completing many high-end kitchen and bath projects, and learned all of the trades needed to complete a project entirely on his own. He’s worked with HDR Remodeling for years and loves the team and clients. On weekends he enjoys barbecuing with his family and riding dirt bikes.

WILSON RAMOS - PROJECT MANAGER

Wilson joined the HDR Remodeling team in 2020. Born and raised in Guatemala, he's lived in the United States for many years and currently resides in Oakland. For nearly a decade, Wilson has been honing his skills as a carpenter in the Bay Area general construction field.

ERIK GASPAR - LEAD CARPENTER

Erik is a highly experienced Lead Carpenter with a strong background in foundation work and electrical carpentry. He takes pride in building things the right way and loves seeing projects come to life from start to finish. Outside of work, Erik enjoys spending time with his family, going on vacations to places like Disneyland and the beach, and celebrating his culture.

FERNANDO GASPAR - CARPENTER

Fernando has ten years of experience and specializes in decks and fencing. In his spare time, he enjoys spending time with his daughter and son.

RIGO GALINDO - CARPENTER

Rigo joined HDR Remodeling with four years of residential construction and one year of commercial construction experience. His experience includes general construction experience such as framing, window installations, and door installations. 

His favorite part about his job is making sure the clients are happy with the work and have an amazing experience – making their dream house become reality. He also appreciates learning new skills during the process. 

In his free time, he enjoys traveling and seeing new places. But most importantly, he enjoys spend time with loved ones.

We've done three construction projects in the past decade, two of them with different contractors and this most recent one with HDR, so we know when things aren't done well. HDR was responsive, they listened, and they did great work. Nothing is ever perfect - there was one sub that didn't do a good job. We didn't have to complain; HDR was on it and they made the sub come back and redo the work. That's the sign of a good contractor.

- Rebecca S.

HDR has been my go-to house projects team for 10+ years. Starting with a complex bathroom remodel, then a collection of smaller projects like a deck and floor replacement and last year a major kitchen remodel.
This group is highly professional, executes on time and does beautiful work. Most importantly, they partner with me as the homeowner, listening carefully to my desires and concerns and address them promptly. They stand by their work and I would not use anyone else.

- Galvan C.

HDR shepherded us through our first remodeling experience, and we really appreciated their professionalism and quality work. We added a bathroom where none existed, and we worked closely with Kevin, Ashley and Julio through the design and construction stages. All of them were considerate, hands-on and professional throughout. Julio's honesty and incredible work ethic really stood out. Additionally, the subcontractors they brought in were considerate of our space and time given we had two young kids running around the house during most of the construction process. We are in love with our new master bath, which is both beautiful and functional.

- Atasi U.

They're not the cheapest out there, but paying a little more buys a lot of peace of mind. The workmanship is excellent and the project was on time and on budget.  -  Steve & Lori A., Kensington, CA 

Bathroom Remodel in Berkeley

HDR created a masterpiece. We could not be happier with our beautiful new kitchen and bathroom. Even with a couple of hitches HDR came through. Ultimate customer satisfaction is foundational to the company. Thank you Team HDR!!

-  Don M., Berkeley

HDR Remodeling designed and constructed a wonderful new kitchen for our Berkeley bungalow style home. It was the first major remodel project we've done and from beginning to end, they exceeded our expectations. The design team really listened to what we wanted and helped bring our vision to life, incorporating new ideas yet maintaining the style and sensibility of the original home, which was important to us. The customer service is really above and beyond in all aspects of the company and I highly recommend them. We love being in our home now, more than ever, and everyone who sees it loves it too.

- Kim B., Berkeley

Kitchen Remodel in Berkeley

We interviewed a few different firms for a kitchen remodel of our small craftsman home. It was immediately clear that HDR was the right choice. We felt an immediate connection with their staff. They approached everything with customer service top of mind and were communicative and organized throughout the design and construction process. They made a very stressful and chaotic process streamlined and smooth. They were also very realistic about timeline. The end result far exceeded our expectations and we highly recommend their end to end service to anyone looking for a dream kitchen or bath.

-  John M., Berkeley

We hired HDR for drainage work and a home remodeling project. They were super responsive, worked with us to come up with a plan that met our most important needs and was within our budget and ultimately delivered high-quality work that we are very happy with to this day. Working with a design-build firm is a little more expensive but in our opinion is worth it in the long run because of the efficiencies and synergy it brings to the whole process. Highly recommend working with HDR!!

-  Andres M., Berkeley 

HDR is a great group - they are knowledgeable, fair and their attention to detail is top notch. The design department is composed of architects and interior designers that really understood my design aesthetics and were flexible and happy to accommodate to my style . The build side of HDR has a dedicated project manager that stayed with us during the entire project, keeping us up to date on what was going on. Happy to recommend them!

- Julia A., Berkeley 

HDR helped us remodel our kitchen and two bathrooms. They were extremely professional and responsive throughout the whole process and did a beautiful job. Our architect, Milton, was great to work with - very responsive to our needs and vision for what the spaces should look like. He did a lot of research for us and always presented various options for how to accomplish the look we wanted - and at various price points. He helped us make all the big and small design decisions. Our contractor, Alberto, was amazing. We met weekly to review progress and answer any questions. Any problems we noticed or things we wanted changed were handled promptly. Even our neighbors noticed how prompt and hard-working our crew was. These are not the typical contractors where you mentally double the estimates they give you for project completion. They estimated 4 months for our project and finished 2 weeks early.

If you want the peace of mind for a project that will be on time, on budget, and high quality, HDR is a great option. I highly recommend them!

-  Ben C., Berkeley

Kitchen Remodel in Oakland

My wife and I are thrilled to emphatically recommend HDR Remodeling to anyone considering them for a remodeling project! After interviewing several local full-service remodeling companies, we hired HDR to lead our whole home remodel, a significant 10-month project that brought our 1923 dilapidated Oakland home into the 21st century. We were sold by their warmth and professionalism, innovative perspective, and confidence to get the job done within the parameters we had in mind.

HDR took care of everything – the structural design and architecture, plans and permitting, interior/exterior design and aesthetics, project management, budget management… you name it, they did it. 

Everyone working at HDR was honest, direct, collaborative, empathetic, and flexible. They were clean, thorough, attentive to detail, and as reliable as you could hope for in this wildly volatile industry. A project this size with this duration is bound to have its issues, and everyone was always pleasant to deal with even (and especially) in the hardest moments. On multiple occasions, they fixed problems at their own cost without trying to negotiate, went above and beyond in upgrading certain designs or materials without charging us, and were always transparent with pricing and options when we had to eat a change order. Don’t get me wrong – anyone taking on this kind of project should expect the timeline and budget to exceed the original projections – but this was way less painful than we feared, largely due to HDR’s professionalism and savvy.

Our project was quite massive for a relatively small Rockridge home. In 2017, we bought a 2 bed, 1 bathroom, 1500 sqft, split-story home that had significant damage requiring remedy (we were fully aware of upon purchase!). Roughly 1 year after we first engaged HDR, we moved back into our 3 bed, 2 bath, 1900 sqft home with the polish and preferences we always dreamed of. Suffice it to say HDR did a phenomenal job with everything. We would absolutely work with HDR again on our next project, and encourage you to give them a call!

- Michael R., Oakland

Last night Ben and I cooked our first meal in the new kitchen—for 10 people! The new space is so great. It's beautiful and it's smart. The flow from kitchen to dining to living makes it feel like a whole new house…

It has been very satisfying to jump in and think with you on so many design decisions and know I could trust you with many others. The craftsmanship is solid and you finished on time. I havnt heard about a single kitchen remodel that finished on time. You have a great team and process.

The project turned out better than I envisioned. I'm thrilled. I want to do it again.

- Ben & Sean, Berkeley, CA

Kitchen Remodel in Richmond

The final product is beyond our dreams. We wake up every day and look at it in awe. Our original house, which HDR converted to open-concept, now matches the style and elegance of the addition that was built 25 years ago. HDR worked with our vision and budget. They were professional, reliable, and kept us apprised. We would happily work with HDR again and recommend them to others.

- Elizabeth & Paul S., Richmond, CA

I chose HDR to build my ADU, because they seemed to be the most savvy, exacting, and the most on top of the Oakland Building Dept's specifications...I'd recommend HDR to anyone considering a remodel or stand-alone unit. HDR's employees are fantastic people and I miss them.

- Jane B., Oakland, CA

Whole Home Remodel in Kensington

This is our second large remodel with HDR. A few years ago they renovated the top floor of our house, and we recently had them back to work on the basement where we carved out a new bedroom from a family room...completely gutted and built a new bathroom, added built-in bookcases, and installed new oak trim throughout. It was a large, 4 month construction project. They're not the cheapest out there, but paying a little more buys a lot of peace of mind. The workmanship is excellent and the project was on time and on budget. 

- Steve & Lori A., Kensington, CA 

Kitchen Remodel and Bathroom Remodel in Oakland

HDR did extensive remodeling of two bathrooms and a kitchen in my condo in Oakland. The designers listened to my requests for special features and found items that complemented the style of my home. The project was carried out on time and within my budget. I'm very happy with the final results—a much brighter, more modern and spacious home. 

Living Room Remodel in Oakland

HDR transformed my living room into a stylish, more functional living space. My new fireplace combines natural materials in a simple, elegant way that is flexible and accommodates my eclectic decorating ideas.

- Janice A., Oakland, CA

I loved their ideas about design and their attention to detail. They really helped with making sure their work looks good. My house has some unusual aspects such as slightly sloping floors. The work they did helped to make these flaws less visible and minimize their impact on the appearance of the new spaces to the absolute greatest degree possible.

- Oakland, CA

We've used HDR for about 5 years now for all sorts of projects: Bathroom remodel, range hood installation, sump pump installation and maintenance, they even helped us find a roofer when we needed a new one. Essentially, they are our go-to people for everything house. I don't know what we'd do with out them! Their team is incredibly professional and talented.

-  Rose L.

ADU in Oakland

This team has insight; and they are incredibly responsive to my requests. Their design guru, Kevin Mond, aces everything. Their project manager, Chris Fellows, is a magician in carrying out the steps necessary to move the project forward. What more can one want?

- Jane B., Oakland, CA

We just completed a bathroom remodel with HDR Remodel and we are so happy with both the finished product and the experience. This was our first remodeling project/experience and they really guided us through it. Jim provided great design advice, and was very patient about providing us choices that worked with our budget. He offered lots of great suggestions along the way but always let us make the final decision, and never pressured us one way or the other. Jim was even completely understanding when I decided to contract out the frameless shower door myself to a glass company since they could do it much cheaper. Other than the shower door, his team took care of ordering all the materials and coordinating the work.

Before construction started, Philip made sure to spell out how they would access the house, how they would contain the area to minimize exposure of dust/dirt to the rest of the house, and asked us to share any concerns/apprehensions that we had so they could do their best to address/prevent them. Guillermo did most of the construction work and was fantastic. Throughout construction, all the workers were very respectful and tried to minimize disturbance to our daily lives, while still providing regular updates on progress or any issues. It was fun to come home each day and see how the bathroom was coming along. We felt we were in good hands the entire time, the job was well-coordinated, and the quality of their work really shows!

- Judy C., Millbrae, CA

We had HDR remodel our kitchen, master bath and fireplace hearth. They excel in coordination during construction to give us the best result in a timely fashion. Their attention to detail is terrific. Even with a few bumps they were able to finish on time. Best of all, they guarantee their work after it is finished and are very prompt should you have any questions or problems. Very reliable!

- Anita W.

HDR did a fabulous job. Every last detail was attended to with great care. They were extremely attentive to my design specifications, and also offered me just the right range of options to choose from in terms of colors, tiles, and so forth: not too many but not too few, some traditional and some modern. Their superior craftsmanship helped me to transform my kitchen and bath into esthetically pleasing and functionally fluid spaces.

- Zachary P., Oakland, CA 

I am very pleased with my new kitchen and master bath. HDR designers helped me to transition from dark and conservative spaces to bright and modern ones. The work was done very efficiently and it was made easy by the excellent staff. Highly recommended.

- Janice  A., Oakland, CA

We recently used HDR for remodeling and expanding our 3 bathrooms and a few other projects around the house. We first worked closely with Jim and Tim for designing, and then with Chris, Alfredo, and Philip for the rest of the process. The entire team is friendly, professional, well-informed in their fields, and overall very pleasant to work with. 

HDR cares very much about client satisfaction and worked with us from beginning to end to make sure we got what we wanted. There were no real problems throughout the entire process, and the small issues that came up were resolved thoroughly. In the end, very happy with the outcome and will return to HDR if we do more work on the house.

- H.K., San Francisco Bay Area

This was my first big renovation project. It was very reassuring to work with people who handled every detail from design through production. I did not have to deal with permits, supervising contractors, etc. I think I avoided many headaches by having this comprehensive service.

- Oakland, CA

Jim and Philip were wonderful to work with. They were always ready to listen to our thoughts and walk us through the details of the project. We remodeled our kitchen and added on a deck, and both of them came out beautifully. They broke the project into two parts (months apart) in order to fit our schedule. The work crews kept the job site in pristine state every night. And they hit the end date on-time (for both parts of the job!) which is quite rare from my understanding. Would highly recommend.

- Derek Y., Oakland, CA

We had always hoped to build a deck in our multi-level, unattractive yard, and HDR made that happen. They were helpful at every stage of the project and all levels of the organization. The design team was cooperative and imaginative. Project management was professional and attentive. Estimated start and finish dates were exact, permits were delivered, adjustments easily accommodated, and change orders minimal. The contracts were clear and billing was courteous. The construction staff, in particular, were expert, orderly, attentive to our needs, respectful of our property. All this at a cost that was reasonable and uncomplicated by conditions. HDR helped make our dreams a reality.

- Michael M., Oakland, CA

We are a growing family and needed a dedicated family room space. The contractor building it wasn't able to finish a downstairs space. It was basically a concrete box. No windows. A little greater than 200 sq ft. We wanted to convert this to a light filled family room and thought that given its relative seclusion, we could add a full bathroom in essence transforming it into an autonomous guest unit if needed. 

Our process began with Kevin, the designer. It actually began with interviewing a number of design build firms in the bay area, including some prominent architects. HDR was an easy choice from the outset. They sought my business and extended themselves in a professional and kind way. Working with Kevin was like finding a new hobby I never knew I was passionate about. He is a creative, proactive, budget conscious individual who is easy to work with. We had to compromise on some plans for a full entertainment center given the bathroom, but he found ways to optimize the extent space that amazed us. 

The build phase was exciting. We benefit from the fact that the remodel was downstairs and thus relatively isolated. Nevertheless we found ourselves purchasing an air purifier. Now matter the level of protection, its not a hermetic seal and so we had some dust. When we were concerned they went over and above to make it as safe as possible. 

The most important items that stood out to us were competency, communication and professionalism. Chris the bossman were on top of all three. They followed rules that maintained our privacy. When there were unforeseen issues, Chris would alert us and we would talk about it. It was all about sticking to a preordained budget.

Timeliness was also important. Even though the project went over by a couple of weeks, it was no unexpected and for reasons that demonstrated HDRs commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction. They were perfectionist about it. The smallest imperfection from a scratched faucet to minuscule divet in the dry wall was redone. The quality is there. The design came to life. 

Our bathroom is ridiculously awesome. A perfect combination of modern and industrial/rustic. I find myself walking all over the house clad in a towel just to use our new space! We are so excited. The new window bring in so much light. The white oak flooring is so warm and inviting. The space is not a basement. It is a continuation of the house and that is the highest compliment we can give them.

- William B., Berkeley, CA

Whole Home Remodel in Oakland

We worked with HDR on three extensive phases of remodeling at our house. The work included converting a sauna to a laundry room, installing hardwood floors throughout the upper level of the house, redoing the layout of and revamping the kitchen, installing a new garage door, updating bathrooms, and redoing some of the exterior finish. We could not be happier with the work. Jim and his design team provided excellent advice and took the time to understand our needs and preferences. Philip, Chris, and Juan were terrific on the production side and did high quality work. It was a pleasure to work with HDR, and we have since recommended them to our family and friends in the area.

- Sameer S., Oakland, CA

After the bathroom remodel was done, designer, Heather, brought up concerns and solutions, which was changing the cabinet's color and light fixture. We satisfied with the light fixture and agreed to change the color of cabinet to suit more the original design idea. They did it for free and we are very satisfied with their professionalism and honesty.

- Berkeley, CA

HDR did an amazing job with the remodel of our upstairs guest bathroom and an expansion/remodel of our master bedroom/bathroom suite. The guest bathroom was straightforward (replaced tile, flooring, cabinetry, fixtures), while the master suite was a bit more complex, involving the addition of a dormer to increase the size of the bathroom and add a walk-in closet. HDR also oversaw several smaller projects, including the installation of a new roof for the whole house and upgraded attic insulation. The end product is absolutely beautiful, but what I am even more impressed by is the overall level of service provided by HDR. The HDR employees greeted my 2 and 4-yr old boys with a wave and smile each morning, they were always respectful and accommodating of our needs, and they insured a very high level of quality in all the work they did and oversaw. I recommend them without any hesitation.

- Heather M.,  Oakland, CA

HDR was great; their attention to detail made our first big home renovation project a wonderful experience. We knew they were good and trustworthy and reliable: we did our homework before choosing who to work with, but we had no idea the level of service we would receive from them. 

They listened to us and understood what we wanted.  They asked us what our top priorities were and within a few days, showed us exactly what we had in mind.  They filtered out what we didn't want, they didn't waste our time and always came prepared. 

It is clear they are exceptional at their job; knowledgeable and easy to work with.  They helped us assess the pros and cons of each decision we needed to make.  There wasn't a moment when we didn't think they had our best interests at heart.  

We appreciate all of the time and efforts they put into working with us.  They were patient with our questions, and we always felt as if we were important.  We love our new kitchen, and feel fortunate to have worked with a team that made the process seem so easy.

- Jennifer S., Oakland, CA

The weekly meetings and Buildertrend were very helpful. They listened to my ideas and found ways to accommodate unusual requests.

- Oakland, CA

Bathroom Remodel and Kitchen Remodel in Alameda

As a top San Francisco Bay Area real estate broker who has appeared on HGTV CNN Money PBS etc I am incredibly selective who I recommend. I have referred many of my clients to HDR and they impress each time. So much so that I have retained their services a couple times for my own property. My kitchen and bathroom remodel were massive undertakings and they handled the projects with their trademark finesse, expertise and artistic eye. The work is magazine editorial worthy!

- Herman C., Alameda, CA

THE DESIGN BUILD DIFFERENCE

We find elegance in designing pragmatically, allowing form to naturally embrace function. We believe that old homes infused with modern touches can seamlessly support the demands of today’s family lifestyles.

Guided by what makes you unique, we design and build spaces in the bay area that intertwines the essence of your home’s history with the rhythm of your life, creating functional living environment that feels both timeless and truly yours.

Compare traditional remodeling with the Design-Build approach to gain a deeper understanding of the benefits and drawbacks of each.

 OUR DESIGN BUILD APPROACH + GUARANTEE

When choosing to work with HDR Remodeling’s Bay Area Design Build firm, you’ll find one capable team of Architects, Designers, and Builders all working together under one roof and sharing a common goal - creating your dream home. 

QUALITY

We demand excellence of our team and specialize in technically challenging home remodels that we know our detail-oriented Builders can execute flawlessly. 

TRANSPARENCY

THE HDR PROCESS

The HDR Remodeling Start-to-Finish Process is a proven approach to successful home remodeling that organizes each project into distinct phases: Planning, Preparation, and Production. 

Our attention to detail in the Planning and Preparation phases helps to ensure that the Production phase of your home remodel runs smoothly. This helps to keep the project on schedule and reduces the likelihood of budget over-runs.

IN HOME CONSULTATION - PLANNING

Our process begins with a complimentary meeting at your home to meet you to review your Wish List. We encourage clients to start a Houzz Ideabook for your home remodel, which helps bring visions to life. The sales person and you can walk through the remodeling project and talk about your ideas to make your house a dream home.

IN OFFICE MEETING - PLANNING

Next, we will invite you to come in for a complimentary meeting at our office and Design studio. We will explore your Design options and discuss estimated cost ranges based on the discussion from the in-home consultation. At this meeting, we most often sign a Design Agreement if we both want to move ahead with the project.

DESIGN - PLANNING & PREPARATION

Once the Design Agreement is signed, the real fun begins! We will use this as a starting point for defining your Design aesthetic.

We recommend you review our past projects to see if there are any looks and styles that appeal to you. 

Our Design + Build Coordinator will work with you to map out a series of Design meetings where you will collaborate on Design and product selections with the HDR team of professionals, a process tailored to your preferred level of involvement in the Design process. The coordinator will offer schematic drawings and cost estimates based on the Design. We will also introduce you to our selection and scheduling software, BuilderTrend.

At the end of the Design phase, we carefully review the final version of the construction contract and, if both parties are in agreement, sign the contract, file for building permits and zoning approval, and schedule the production start date.

BUILD - PRODUCTION

Once the contract is signed and the deposit is received, we will order the materials. We do not start a project until all the materials are on the job site and inspected. This ensures that you will not be under construction any longer than necessary.

A “Pass the Baton” meeting is held between you and the Design and Production teams to ensure a seamless transition that cannot be found outside of a full service Design + Build firm. This will include a pre-construction walk through. 

With the materials on the job site, we will start the production phase and build according to the specifications in the remodeling contract and the approved plans. We strive to provide excellent service to meet your expectations at each phase of the remodeling project. The Lead Carpenter assigned to your job will be on site every day unless you are notified otherwise. Our Head of Production will visit the site approximately every other day and always on Friday to review the progress.

AFTER ACTION - POST-PRODUCTION

When the job is complete, we will schedule a personal post-production walk through with you. This will give you a chance to review the work and sign off on the finished project. Next, we schedule a professional photo shoot of the completed project for submission in local and national awards.
